account.description: Open a pipeline account for the requester's company in the first stage, with the next action "Reply to the request". Needs a pipeline.

events.description: For github_repo: star, fork, issue, discussion (discussion needs ASTROLABE_GITHUB_TOKEN).

every.description: How often to run, e.g. 1h (at least 15m).

fields.description: Form field names by Astrolabe key (email, name, company, domain, role, source, campaign, message). Common names are matched when a key is not set.

form.description: For netlify_forms: the form's name (the name attribute of the HTML form).

query.description: GitHub issue search syntax; one phrase works best.

reception.description: Also file each result in the reception log as a public mention.

repo.description: owner/name of a repo to watch.

respond.description: How soon to reply, e.g. 1d (default); the account's next action is due then.

signal.description: Signal type it produces, e.g. github.issue_pain.

site.description: For netlify_forms: the Netlify site id or name (like mysite.netlify.app).

strength.description: How strong each signal is (1-100); 25 is a strong buying signal.

type.description: github_search, github_repo, community, github_release (download, star and issue counts; no people), netlify_forms (polls a Netlify form's verified submissions; needs ASTROLABE_NETLIFY_TOKEN), or form_webhook (receives signed POSTs at /hooks/forms/<product>; never polled).
